name: LinkPeek
tagline: See the media behind a link without leaving the page.
description:
A touchpad-first Chromium and Helium extension that turns links into fast media previews. It classifies destinations, understands Discourse threads, prefers original uploads over page chrome, and gives one-handed gallery navigation without making you leave the page.

Interactive onboarding, searchable settings, presets, per-site profiles, privacy controls and a REX Technologies GitHub Pages install site ship with the extension.
highlights: Whole-thread Discourse media extraction with original/preview pairing and deduplication
One-handed touchpad browsing, scrub and zoom controls
Deep searchable settings with presets and per-site overrides
Direct CRX build and GitHub Pages distribution pipeline
Browser-level Playwright E2E coverage for the packaged extension
